summary:
ASTRO HEALTH
An AI-Powered Human Health & Environmental Intelligence Platform

ASTRO HEALTH, developed by NEBULA-Y, is an innovative health-intelligence platform designed to explore the relationship between human physiology, environmental conditions, and space-health research.

The platform brings together physiological health measurements, environmental information, and NASA space-health research to support a broader understanding of human health.

Its AI-assisted analysis engine examines available data, identifies potentially unusual patterns, and generates explainable health-related insights.

ASTRO HEALTH has two primary application directions: Earth Health Intelligence and Space Health Intelligence. Its long-term vision is to develop an advanced AI system capable of analyzing multiple sources of health and environmental data to support personalized health-risk assessment and scientific research.

Our vision: Understand the human body. Understand its environment. Advance health intelligence on Earth and beyond.
details:
ASTRO HEALTH, developed by team NEBULA-Y, is an AI-assisted human health and environmental intelligence platform designed to explore the relationship between human physiology, environmental conditions, and space-health research.

The platform brings together three major information areas: human health data, environmental intelligence, and scientific space-health research. It is designed with two monitoring profiles: Earth Health Monitoring and Space Health Monitoring.

The software provides an interactive dashboard where users can explore physiological measurements such as heart rate, oxygen saturation (SpO₂), body temperature, blood pressure, and respiratory information. Its environmental intelligence concept focuses on factors such as air quality, temperature, humidity, UV exposure, and weather conditions.

ASTRO HEALTH also integrates NASA's Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) research search functionality to help explore scientific studies related to space biology, human physiology, microgravity, and radiation effects.

The current prototype uses simulated physiological telemetry and a rule-based AI screening engine to identify potentially unusual measurements and generate explainable results. It is built using Python, FastAPI, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Our project's creativity lies in connecting human health, environmental conditions, and space-health research within one platform instead of treating them as separate information sources.

The intended impact is to support better understanding of environmental health influences, encourage research into human adaptation to extreme environments, and establish a foundation for future personalized health-risk analysis.

Future development includes real wearable-device integration, live environmental data collection, historical health analytics, and trained predictive AI models. ASTRO HEALTH is currently a research-oriented prototype, not a clinically validated diagnostic system.
